profile.headline: Team lead /  Fullstack Developer
profile.summary: Yung and aspiring, my priority on life is to gain enough experience  to call myself an IT master able to create  things that most of the people can’t,  so far i have been participating on good projects, from the building to the support and maintenance,  that experience enhance my knowledge on certain areas,  but my goal is to create new projects out of nowhere that change the lifestyle  of people.

positions.title: Sr. Back end engineer
positions.description: Lead backend engineering efforts within the Fraud Prevention division, specifically focusing on the architecture and development of the Fraud Orchestrator API. This mission-critical system automates the vetting of credit applications by performing real-time risk assessments and multi-vendor data orchestration.
positions.insights: Skills: java 17 · Spring Boot · Spring Batch · MongoDB · OpenShift · Kubernetes · Spring Security

positions.title: Sr. Software engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Backend Developer at Comtec within the Hilton Hotels division, I participate on  the maintenance of the Hilton HMS application, serving as a middleware broker facilitating seamless communication between the Hilton infrastructure and our valued clientele. 

Noteworthy achievements during my tenure include:

●	Integration of digital key functionality, enabling guests to utilize their smartphones instead of traditional keys. This endeavor involved the utilization of a Kafka broker for internal communication and Amazon AWS for data hosting and Lambda functions.
●	Successful migration of the application from Java 8 to Java 17.
●	Development and enhancement of Splunk queries to construct dashboards for activity monitoring and automated alerts.

Responsibilities:

●	Developing and maintaining server-side logic using Java and JSP Servlets.
●	Designing, implementing, and managing data within PostgreSQL databases.
●	Optimizing database queries for enhanced efficiency and performance.
●	Building and managing RESTful APIs for seamless communication with Hilton's systems.
●	Deploying server applications on AWS cloud infrastructure.
●	Implementing CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment procedures.
●	Setting up and maintaining monitoring tools to proactively track server performance and identify potential issues.
●	Creating automated testing protocols to prevent the introduction of bugs into the application.
●	Generating comprehensive technical documentation for backend systems and APIs.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Maintaining and patching internal applications for our customers witch belong to the banking industry,  such internal applications where based on Java 1.6 and 1.7  mainly,  but  also   required handling frameworks such as  Hibernate and  Spring, Junit, Mockito  etc. Report creation, and high standards of control where required due to the nature of the project.   

Additional to my Daily task, I participate on several internal initiatives, the most remarkable was my leadership on a team called CFT, as such I owned a team of about 10 people,   our task where to maintain Hardware & Software for new arrivals to the GDCE or just new requirements, this was a particular challenge, not because of the complexity of the job but because of the time it demand. 

My name also appear on the fun at work committee, and the internal TCS magazine. 

Remarkable as well the creation of an automated tool I made to fill reports automatically and post them.  To our repository.

positions.description: Application Owner and  trouble solver,  on Flextronics I used to belong to a  global L3  Functional  Team in charge of controlling the internal logistic for  Flextronics,  Main tools  that I use here where SQL for  querying  and analyzing data,  Linux  skills mainly  to  fins information on logs,  and run/create Scripts.
